A residential fire affected 43 families in Barangay Cembo, Taguig on March 26. 

The Taguig City Fire Station reported that the fire started at about 11:41 p.m. from a house owned by a 70-year-old man on Taguile Street in the barangay.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In view of “Satrangi Re by Sonu Nigam Live Music Concert” at Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium on 28.03.2026, certain traffic restrictions will be effective.

Time: 04:00 PM – 11:00 PM (Peak restrictions from 02:00 PM – 10:00 PM)

📍 LIKELY AFFECTED STRETCH
-IP Marg (MGM Road)
-Vikas Marg
-Ring Road (Rajghat to IP Depot)

📍STADIUM ENTRY
-Gates 07 & 08: Via Velodrome Road
-Gates 16, 18, 21 & 22: Via MGM Road

📍PARKING ADVISORY
-Entry to parking only with valid labels via MGM Road
-Follow designated routes for smooth access

📍Avoid affected stretches & plan your journey in advance

📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels

#DPTrafficAdvisory
